sloka: स सायको राघवबाहुचोदितो दिशः स्वभासा दश सम्प्रकाशयन्।सधूमवैश्वानरदीप्तदर्शनो जगाम शक्राशनिवीर्यविक्रमः ।। ६.६७.१५६ ।।
transliteration: sa sāyako rāghavabāhucodito diśaḥ svabhāsā daśa samprakāśayan।sadhūmavaiśvānaradīptadarśano jagāma śakrāśanivīryavikramaḥ ।। 6.67.156 ।।

translations.english: The enemy of Lord Indra drank the arrows through his body and hurled his club at great speed whirling it round and round arrested the arrows of Rama.
